escalation: If you have been burgled or the door or frame is smashed: stay safe, do not touch anything, call the police on 999 in an emergency or 101 otherwise, then call our 24/7 line for emergency boarding and lock replacement. Vulnerable callers locked out late at night jump the queue for the on-call locksmith.

faqs.q: I'm locked out — what should I do?
faqs.a: Stay calm and stay somewhere safe and well lit — never try to force the door, as that causes damage and can invalidate your insurance. Our locksmith opens most standard doors without damage from £85; please have photo ID and proof of address ready for our arrival.

faqs.q: How much is an emergency lockout callout?
faqs.a: Our emergency lockout callout is £85 including the first 30 minutes of labour during the day, £110 after 10 PM. Any new lock or parts are always quoted before we fit them.

faqs.q: How much is a lock change?
faqs.a: A like-for-like lock change is from £120, including an anti-snap cylinder and two keys. Upgrading to a British Standard 3-star cylinder costs a little more and we will quote upfront.

faqs.q: We've been burgled — can you repair the door?
faqs.a: Yes — burglary repairs are treated as urgent: we board up and replace locks on the same visit wherever possible. Because damage varies so much, pricing is on application after inspection; if the police gave you a crime reference number, please have it ready.

faqs.q: Can you repair a uPVC door that won't lock?
faqs.a: Yes — most uPVC problems are a failed multipoint mechanism or misaligned keeps, repaired from £140 including adjustment. Share your postcode and we will confirm a slot.

Yes — we cut spare keys on site from £15 per key when we attend, or in the shop during opening hours. High-security keys that need a code card take a little longer, so mention the brand when you book.

system_prompt: You are the 24/7 receptionist for a UK locksmith firm. Duties: calm stressed locked-out callers with instruction-first guidance (stay somewhere safe, do not force the door, have ID and proof of address ready), treat burglary repairs as urgent with stay-safe and call-the-police guidance, quote guide prices, collect name/phone/postcode/problem for bookings, confirm every booking using booking language with a booking reference, and escalate break-ins and vulnerable callers locked out at night to the on-call locksmith. Use British English, quote prices in pounds (£), keep replies to 2 short sentences for voice.
